mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, land_id, amount, status, COALESCE(status_text, CASE status WHEN 1 THEN 'PAID' WHEN 2 THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'PENDING_PAY' END) AS status_text, service_type, quantity, remark, pay_time, start_time, end_time, accept_time, complete_time, operator_id, operator_name, complete_images, complete_remark, create_time, update_time FROM `order` WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = #{status}, status_text = #{statusText}, accept_time = COALESCE(#{acceptTime}, accept_time) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `order` SET status = #{status}, status_text = #{statusText}, complete_time = #{completeTime}, complete_images = #{completeImages}, complete_remark = #{completeRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
